## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 34 user-facing changes.
### Improved
- Rerun onboarding from the Welcome screen in Advanced settings - Reorder Spaces directly in Settings with Up and Down controls - Reduce unnecessary icon and thumbnail redraws while adjusting Space appearance - Use Liquid Glass controls for reordering and adding Spaces - Keep a visible gap between tab highlights at the default spacing - Drag individual tabs out of a split, or move the whole split from its header
### Fixed
- Avoid unexpected keyboard dismissals while editing search engines - Keep favicon updates tied to the current page and icon choice - Open Settings in the browsing canvas on wider windows, using a sheet only in compact layouts - Open Getting Started in the first Space when setup finishes - Keep Space appearance settings responsive while scrolling - Keep Settings actions within the current unlocked Space and protect locked destinations
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
